Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to execute the instruction to open the Wikipedia page (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Benito_Perojo) in Step 4. Instead, it repeatedly navigated to the IMDb page (https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0674398/), which it had already accessed in previous steps. This prevented the agent from gathering the conflicting data point (Las Palmas de Gran Canaria) from Wikipedia that was necessary to identify the discrepancy between sources. By not visiting the requested URL, the agent missed a crucial step in the triangulation process required to resolve the conflicting birthplace information.
